purpose: Curated fact and uncertainty index. Function reconstruction and verification statuses remain authoritative in provenance/functions.

facts.title: Boot segment 0 source identity
facts.statement: The verified U98 extraction produced segment 0 with 208048 bytes and SHA-256 5dd923067b1a3398d4d26b6558e46cf396ab69b66afd5f8b183885b820e79b79.
scope: KI v1.5d U98 boot segment 0 source fingerprint
facts.limits: This source fingerprint is not semantic coverage and does not identify every disk-loaded region.
facts.invalidation: A clean extraction from the declared input produces different bytes or a source record names another load identity.

facts.title: Bounded type-0x1a render bridge comparison
facts.statement: The display-class-0x60, flags-zero type-0x1a bridge has 315 controlled native descriptor comparisons.
facts.limits: Projected fields 0x68/0x6c/0x70 and frame pointer 0x30 are upstream inputs; alternate classes and nonzero flags are outside the comparison.
facts.invalidation: Any fixture case or independently regenerated trace differs from the native descriptor.

facts.title: Emitter countdown and cadence semantics
facts.statement: Fighter bytes 0xc4 and 0xc5 control emitter countdown and cadence, and the stored byte truncation does not truncate the comparison register.
facts.limits: This does not recover a universal fighter layout or the caller scheduler.
facts.invalidation: A controlled original decision disagrees with the declared untruncated comparison or memory access order.

facts.title: Observed contact seed
facts.statement: Executing stores in the controlled contact recorded receiver c4/c5/c6/c7 as 31/78/55/00 hexadecimal.
scope: verified contact initializer and controlled Jago-versus-idle-Fulgore contact
facts.limits: The 152-byte initializer is verified; surrounding hit selection, collision, damage and scheduling are not.
facts.invalidation: A repeat of the same declared scenario produces different executing store values after input identity is confirmed.

facts.title: Type-0x1a constructor state contract
facts.statement: The constructor reads fighter positions 0x04/0x08/0x0c, direction 0x74/0x78, and impact bytes 0xc4/0xc6/0xc7, then initializes one particle record.
facts.limits: Future mixed-ABI callers must independently establish required live register and continuation state.
facts.invalidation: A controlled case changes memory outside the contract or exposes an omitted required input/output.

facts.title: Secondary-record allocator boundary
facts.statement: The allocator searches 29 0x100-byte records from 0x8808be00, then clears and returns unchecked fallthrough record 0x8808db00.
facts.limits: The fallthrough record's broader semantic purpose and surrounding memory remain unmapped.
facts.invalidation: A controlled all-occupied case does not clear 0x8808db00 or reveals a failure branch.

facts.title: Saved constructor return address
facts.statement: The emitter call causes saved-return global 0x88087274 to receive 0x88003d6c.
facts.limits: Temporary registers and wider guest liveness remain outside the current memory-oriented API.
facts.invalidation: Original call-boundary evidence or native composition produces another saved address.

facts.title: Observed particle animation lookup
facts.statement: Original byte 0x8800b2d8 selects animation index 0x0c; entry 0x8805e370 installed script 0x8805e6f2 in the observed revision.
facts.limits: General animation grammar, null-script initialization, and full load derivation remain open.
facts.invalidation: Verified source bytes or executing loads for the declared revision select a different entry or script.

facts.title: Observed complete impact counts
facts.statement: One controlled impact has 49 eligible emitter invocations, 7 allocations, 322 particle updates, 315 draws across 96 visible groups, and 7 releases.
scope: repeated controlled Jago Endokuken impact on idle Fulgore
facts.limits: These counts do not establish VBlank timing, a fixed tick, or game completeness.
facts.invalidation: A repeat with the same declared inputs and event normalization has a different sequence or digest.

evidence.locator: complete observed impact has 322 particle updates, 315 render calls across

facts.title: Emitter invocation spacing
facts.statement: Particles are emitted at eligible invocation indexes 0, 8, 16, 24, 32, 40, and 48; visible groups 1 through 3 omit a receiver invocation while particles continue updating.
facts.limits: The cause is unresolved and must not become hardcoded skip logic or a once-per-frame assumption.
facts.invalidation: Event-level repeatability fails or the grouping boundary is shown to combine unrelated events.

facts.title: Update order differs from draw order
facts.statement: Secondary updates were observed in ascending record address, while draw traversal uses a different recorded order.
facts.limits: General ordering dependencies, slot reuse, camera, and world/depth inputs remain unrecovered.
facts.invalidation: A controlled ordered trace contradicts either traversal for the same state.

facts.title: Historical frame-slot cache claim refuted
facts.statement: The old 0x88090164 marker was computed by instrumentation, while the executing class-11 load used 0x88090140 and agreed with debugger backing there; no same-address cache mismatch was demonstrated.
facts.limits: This refutes only the historical 0x88090164 example and does not establish general CPU/debugger cache coherence.
facts.invalidation: A register-level trace demonstrates that this selected load actually used 0x88090164 or disagreed with backing at the executing 0x88090140 address.

facts.title: Static secondary dispatch candidate
facts.statement: Static inspection finds table 0x8803416c indexed by type times four, a type-0x1a target of 0x88004e54, and 0x100-byte record traversal.
facts.limits: The complete dispatcher, fighter follow-up, caller scheduling, and all type handlers are not reconstructed or dynamically verified.
facts.invalidation: Original bytes, target computation, or executing control flow contradicts this static mapping.

facts.title: Static receiver gate candidate
facts.statement: Static inspection finds global byte 0x88087aec read at 0x88002a70 and a branch at 0x88002a74 that can skip the fighter path.
scope: candidate branch in common fighter updater
facts.limits: This is not live proof that the branch causes the three omitted receiver invocations.
facts.invalidation: A live omitted interval does not take the gate or another path fully explains the omission.

facts.title: Static contact lookup layout
facts.statement: The draft contact block statically uses row base 0x88034610 and variant mapping 0x88034647, whose addressed ranges can overlap.
facts.limits: Lookup and alias semantics are verified only at this bounded initializer ABI, not wider descriptor ownership or scheduling.
facts.invalidation: Accepted original evidence disagrees with the address calculation or access ordering.

facts.title: Working driver hardware baseline
facts.statement: The current driver baseline places alternating framebuffers at low-RAM offsets 0x30000 and 0x58000 and assigns asymmetric read/write meanings to control addresses.
scope: current MAME KI1 driver working baseline
facts.limits: A driver map is not an executed game device/event contract, and KI2 mappings do not apply.
facts.invalidation: The selected driver revision or original execution establishes different KI1 meanings.

evidence.locator: This is a working baseline, not a definitive description

uncertainties.title: Contact initializer exactness
uncertainties.impact: The bounded initializer no longer blocks its dependents after independent acceptance.
uncertainties.limits: Resolution covers the declared memory ABI only; surrounding hit logic and scheduling remain separate open work.
uncertainties.invalidation: Any changed byte, access order, original output, or bounded native memory effect reopens the uncertainty.
alternatives: read-order, alias, or wrap error in the draft
uncertainties.next_experiment: Retain the two accepted 18-case evidence identities and rerun after any initializer ABI or harness change.

uncertainties.title: Cause of three omitted receiver updates
scope: receiver caller gating and visible event grouping
uncertainties.impact: Blocks faithful caller scheduling and the integrated native effect.
uncertainties.limits: The 0x88087aec gate is only a static candidate.
uncertainties.invalidation: The candidate gate is not taken during omitted intervals.
uncertainties.next_experiment: Capture gate values and writes, dispatch, contact, particle updates, framebuffer changes, and both fighters in one run.

evidence.locator: three omitted invocations has **not** been recovered

uncertainties.title: Executable/data/load classification
scope: selected runnable slices and loaded regions
uncertainties.impact: Blocks finite executable closure and safe wider translation.
uncertainties.limits: Boot segment 0 and current entry points are partial coverage.
uncertainties.invalidation: New executable identities invalidate address-only dispatch for the affected slice.
alternatives: fixed loaded code for a bounded slice
additional disk code, overlays, or mutation
uncertainties.next_experiment: Combine source-to-destination load mapping, static targets, runtime loads, and code-write observations for a finite slice.

evidence.locator: U98 is still not the whole game.

uncertainties.title: Mixed-ABI helper safety
scope: generated callers and manual native helpers
uncertainties.impact: Blocks a trustworthy mixed generated/manual ABI.
uncertainties.limits: Current memory-oriented helper contracts do not include a full CPU context.
uncertainties.invalidation: Any required live register, HI/LO, return, or continuation effect is absent from an adapter.
uncertainties.next_experiment: Perform original caller/callee liveness analysis and a mixed-ABI differential harness over the selected boundary.

uncertainties.title: Spawn positions and update/draw ordering
uncertainties.impact: Blocks capture-free multi-particle state and draw ordering.
uncertainties.limits: One captured scenario may hide camera, depth, reuse, or priority dependencies.
uncertainties.invalidation: Any unexplained original/native position or ordering difference keeps the proposed model open.
uncertainties.next_experiment: Capture ordered receiver, dispatch, update, and render checkpoints across mirrored, overlapping, and reused-slot cases.

uncertainties.title: Projection and frame-pointer derivation
uncertainties.impact: Blocks removal of captured render transforms and frame selections.
uncertainties.limits: The current bridge starts from supplied projected fields and a valid frame pointer.
uncertainties.invalidation: Source-derived upstream state cannot reproduce the existing bridge inputs.
alternatives: additional table, load, direction, or cache variants are required
uncertainties.next_experiment: Trace executing projection and lookup loads with source-derived tables, multiple sides, scales, tokens, and bounds.

uncertainties.title: Faithful static translator route
uncertainties.impact: Blocks selection of an economical scalable recompilation path.
uncertainties.limits: Verified manual routines do not establish a scalable translation route.
uncertainties.invalidation: Unsupported semantics or runtime decoding defeats a candidate.
uncertainties.next_experiment: Compare candidates on the same finite direct/indirect mixed-call pilot, including licensing, reproducibility, and diagnostics.

uncertainties.title: Exact event and device contracts
uncertainties.impact: Blocks faithful guest scheduling and hardware service integration.
uncertainties.limits: Driver VBlank, ATA, and control mappings do not prove a fixed tick or complete IRQ/CP0/cache behavior.
uncertainties.invalidation: Host refresh or event tie-order changes canonical original/native outcomes.
alternatives: finer logical clock and cache/device interactions are required
uncertainties.next_experiment: Trace reads, writes, interrupts, acknowledgments, and load completion against executing CPU state and justified tie ordering.

uncertainties.title: Clean startup and data derivation

uncertainties.impact: Blocks clean startup and removal of opaque state captures.
uncertainties.limits: A RAM match is not an initialization recipe and disk-loaded mutable tables remain dependencies.

alternatives: additional executed initialization or patches are required

uncertainties.impact: Blocks selection and implementation of the faithful audio boundary.
uncertainties.limits: The hardware register baseline is not a complete DSP, timing, priority, or command model.

uncertainties.title: Content outside the current scenario

uncertainties.impact: Blocks content completeness and later product acceptance claims.
uncertainties.limits: One effect and bounded routine cases do not establish content coverage.

alternatives: indispensable local artifacts remain outside recoverable manifests
uncertainties.next_experiment: Restore-check the exact approved metadata allowlist and separately test regeneration recipes for excluded evidence; obtain explicit approval before external storage.
